error.message: Illustrative, against a hypothetical later catalog that declares a metered funding source; catalog 1.1.0 declares none. Every option that could serve this request is billable, and the request did not set allow_metered. No non-metered profile was substituted because none exists for this request. Read the origin of the billable option carefully: it is NOT an exhausted subscription that turned into per-token spend. Subscription pools declare spillover: none, so exhausting one makes it unavailable and nothing else. The billable candidate here exists only because this catalog independently declares openai-payg as its own funding source, with its own credential, gated behind allow_metered intent plus metered-spend authorization. Authorizing that spend is a human decision, per attempt, and is recorded; a client that resends with allow_metered on its own has defeated the control (invariant 4).
